customManagers.description: A bump of the actionlint version also needs the new release sums in the same file.
scripts/check-oidc-jobs.ts pins the Publish job's action SHAs, so a bump in release.yml lands in the same PR: same depName, same branch.

packageRules.description: One PR bumps .tool-versions and devEngines.runtime; pnpm regenerates the lockfile entry. scripts/check-node-version.ts guards the three copies. Renovate reads no locked version for devEngines.runtime, so an in-range release has no npm update; bump moves the range.
@types/node stays on the runtime's major, which scripts/check-node-version.ts enforces. Raise the cap in the PR that moves the Node.js runtime to a new major.

One PR bumps the pnpm/setup version pin in release.yml and the lockfile's pnpm, which scripts/check-oidc-jobs.ts holds equal. Renovate reads no locked version for devEngines.packageManager, so an in-range release has no npm update; bump moves the range, and pnpm regenerates the lockfile entry.
